title: max_reg Placement Options
summary: Three ways to place max_reg (22 flops, a signed 22-bit compare and the load mux) were tried in the chip against free placement: (b) only the 22 M flops fixed in a column; (b) the M flops and mac_unit's S flops fixed and bit-aligned; (a) a whole bit-sliced block fixed (sdffq_1 per bit with a compare slice). Every other cell was placed by the tool.

decision.label: Not adopted; superseded by cluster design (D7)
decision.text: No constrained option reduced chip area legally. b_m came in 35 µm² under the baseline, inside run-to-run noise, with an identical netlist and 4 cap violations. b_ms and the fixed block were larger and added wire (+8.8 mm and +12.2 mm). The block's own cells (2,952.5 µm²) only match the cells synthesis already gives max_reg inside the chip (2,954.7 µm²), so the loss comes from the rest of the chip being mapped and placed around it. max_reg will be placed together with mac_unit's S register and adder slice. The v2 block (63 × 22 sites, 96.6% packing, 2 split SE drivers) is kept as a building block.

runs.label: b_m: 22 M flops fixed in a column
runs.note: Synthesized netlist byte-identical to the baseline; the flops are mapped by Q net and all 22 held FIXED.

runs.label: b_ms: M and S flops fixed, bit-aligned
runs.note: 44 flops fixed; the netlist is byte-identical to the baseline.

runs.label: a_sdff v1: whole bit-sliced block fixed
runs.note: 109 cells fixed, 70 × 23 sites. Review B1: one buf_4 drove 22 SE pins, and repair added a dlyb_1 inside the block. v2 fixes this; v2 was not hardened.

verification: Frozen max_reg contract (hash 6d7f5b5ff9a94fc9): 17/17 RTL; 35/35 must-kill mutants killed; 3 survivors proven equivalent.
a_sdff v1 and v2 netlists: frozen contract in gate mode 19/19 (eqy_rtl proven). The orchestrator reran v2 itself.
Placement validator ALL_OK (v2): 12/12 self-tests fire only on their own check; 262,208 functional vectors with 0 mismatches.
All runs: setup and hold met at every corner; DRC, LVS and antenna 0. The independent review (round 1) confirmed every table number against the raw metrics.
